title: The CD47-signal regulatory protein alpha (SIRPa) interaction is a therapeutic target for human solid tumors
central_claims: CD47 blockade enables macrophage phagocytosis and inhibits human solid-tumor growth, including in immunocompetent breast-tumor mice.
